reviews.author: Ayman Agami
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Ramy Gents Salon, and I have to say that Yahia is truly exceptional. From the moment I sat in his chair, I knew I was in professional hands. He pays incredible attention to detail, understands exactly what you want, and delivers results beyond expectations.
Yahia is not just a barber — he’s an artist. His precision, clean fades, and smooth finishing touches make a huge difference. He takes his time to ensure everything is perfect, and you can tell he genuinely cares about his work and his clients.
The atmosphere of the salon is great, clean, and welcoming, but what really stands out is Yahia’s skill and professionalism. I left feeling confident, fresh, and completely satisfied.
If you’re looking for the best barber experience, I highly recommend asking for Yahia — you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Honey
reviews.text:
I would like to share some feedback regarding our experience at Ramy Salon yesterday.

My husband and son are regular customers, especially my husband, who visits almost twice a month. We keep coming back because of the excellent service we consistently receive. In fact, I would still highly recommend your salon and give it a good rating because of the great service provided, especially by the Filipino staff member who usually attends to my husband and son.

However, I would like to express my disappointment about what happened yesterday after my husband’s haircut.

I understand that Ramy Salon is not specifically a children’s salon, but this was not my son’s first haircut there. In fact, it was already his fifth time having his haircut at your salon. We always choose to have his haircut done by the Filipino barber because he has always been very patient and understanding, even when my son cries due to being scared of the razor.

Unfortunately, yesterday, as soon as the filipino barber will start cutting my son’s hair and my son began crying, not even 30 seconds had passed when another staff member, an Egyptian barber, approached and whispered something to the Filipino barber. He then told us to stop the haircut because my son was crying and said that other customers might complain.

What disappointed me was that it seemed he had already assumed customers would complain simply because my son was crying. I did not hear or see any customer expressing a complaint. It felt like a decision was made based on an assumption rather than an actual issue.

I completely understand that not everyone is comfortable with a child crying, and I respect that. However, the way the situation was handled made me feel unwelcome. Because of that, we decided to leave, as I did not want to continue receiving a service when it seemed that someone was unhappy with us being there.

Thank you for taking the time to read. I hope you can understand my frustration regarding what happened. My intention is simply to share our experience, as we have always enjoyed your service and have been loyal customers for quite some time.

reviews.author: Stenin Tony
reviews.text:
**Worst experience ever. Absolutely horrible.** 😡

I showed them a clear reference picture and somehow they managed to give me the **complete opposite of what I asked for**. My hair was literally ruined.

It honestly felt like they were using my head as a **testing ground** rather than actually knowing what they were doing. If you’re not confident about recreating a hairstyle, just say so instead of experimenting on a customer.

I trusted them with my hair and walked out extremely disappointed and frustrated. **Zero professionalism, zero attention to the reference, and absolutely no regard for the customer’s expectations.**

Would **NOT recommend this place to anyone**. If you value your hair, think twice before going here. 💀
